beats.title: Coliseum fight begins with shifting arena terrain and elemental damage
beats.summary: The championship battle opens with dramatic arena changes as meteor impacts reshape the battlefield. Bonogo and Ogonob focus on the Storm Elemental while Baergrom pressures the Stone Elemental, and the Storm Elemental responds with lightning and duplication.

beats.title: Storm Elemental falls; Stone Elemental remains under pressure as terrain worsens
beats.summary: The fight escalates with collapsing ground, lava, and close-quarters attacks. Bonogo and Ogonob help finish the Storm Elemental, while Baergrom struggles with weapon loss, heavy retaliation, and the battlefield turning more hazardous around the remaining elemental.
